entities.summary: Nathan Alexander Evans is a Scottish singer. He first gained fame in 2020 by posting videos of himself singing sea shanties on the social media service TikTok. In 2021, he released a version of the folk song "Wellerman", which peaked at the top of the UK Singles Chart and also charted in several other countries. His debut album, Wellerman – The Album, was released in 2022 and achieved moderate success in continental Europe. It peaked at number twelve on the albums charts in Germany, as well as reaching number thirty in Switzerland.
